# QC Change Checklist

## Change Type

- [ ] Context only
- [ ] Test plan generated
- [ ] Test plan reviewed
- [ ] Tests generated
- [ ] Tests reviewed
- [ ] Tests promoted
- [ ] Healing change
- [ ] External verification
- [ ] Framework / governance change

## Required Evidence

- Project key:
- User request:
- Rule files read:
- Context files read:
- Test plan used:
- Reviewed test plan path:
- Tests generated:
- Commands executed:
- Production write involved: yes / no
- External systems involved:
- Cleanup strategy:
- Risks:
- Open questions:

## AI Safety Confirmation

- [ ] No business tests were generated without reviewed test plan.
- [ ] No business rules were invented.
- [ ] No selectors were invented without context.
- [ ] No API endpoints were invented without context.
- [ ] No secrets were hardcoded.
- [ ] No production write was added.
- [ ] No assertions were weakened.
- [ ] No failing tests were skipped without approval.
- [ ] Generated tests were not directly promoted.
